title: Senior Data Scientist, Workforce Management Analytics
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Support Group

As the name Support Group implies, this group is responsible for the core part of the customer experience journey that has got Wolt top-notch ratings in app stores. 

During the years we’ve invested a lot in the in-house built support tooling as we believe that it’s the only way we can ensure the satisfaction of all of our customers and partners in each of the 25 countries that we operate in. We take huge pride in our customer operations’ quality, so on top of building delightful support experiences in our consumer app we also want to proactively identify and solve issues even before our customers and partners even notice something might be wrong.

About the Support Analytics Team

Our Support Analytics team’s main goal is to deliver an amazing Customer, Merchants & Courier support experience while optimizing our operations by providing actionable insights and quantifying the impact of those actions on the overall business. 💡 

You’ll be part of this team working with top Data Science and Analytics Engineering professionals.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the frontlines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.

Your job will mainly focus on driving operational efficiency with the  Workforce Management (WFM) team and optimizing resource allocation by creating accurate scheduling and intraday forecasts, simplifying forecasting processes, building and supporting KPI dashboards, conducting root cause analysis for SLA improvements, exploring cost optimization opportunities, managing the capacity plan framework, enhancing the WFM data pipeline, and uncovering data-driven insights to refine planning, scheduling, reporting, and intraday management.

Our humble expectations

Required:

• 5+ years of experience in a data science or analytics position

• Experience building forecasting models and time series analysis (Prophet, SARIMA, Holt-Winters or similar)

• Experience in Cost Analysis and What-if Scenario Analysis

• Deep knowledge of statistical packages in Python or R

• Proficiency in writing structured and efficient SQL queries for large data sets

• Ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders Good to have:

• Experience using ML for forecasting

• Experience working with ML engineers/ML platform

• Building data pipelines using Airflow or similar tools

What we offer

• The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.

• You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote in Berlin. 💙

title: VP, Enterprise Accounts
description:
Overview
Vice President, Enterprise Accounts
The Judge Group , ranked the 12th largest IT staffing firm in the United States, is seeking a Vice President, Enterprise Accounts to hunt, break and build enterprise accounts. This is a strategic sales role focused on selling our portfolio of technology, talent and learning solutions across various industries including the financial, healthcare and life sciences sectors.
Who is Judge?
The Judge Group , established in 1970, is an international professional services firm headquartered in the Greater Philadelphia area. Judge is a global leader in technology consulting, staffing solutions, corporate training, and human capital management. Our solutions are delivered through an annual workforce of 9,000 professionals and 30+ office locations across the United States, Canada, and India. Judge is committed to the success of our clients, consultants, and employees. By joining our team, you will be part of an established, growing, and innovative culture that makes developing employees' top priority.
What Judge will provide you?

• Industry leading delivery team with delivery centers in the US and India

• A well formulated career path with exceptional opportunity for growth

• Industry leading sales training program

• The opportunity to join one of the fastest growing and highly regarded staffing firms in the industry

• Fast paced, performance-based organization that publicly and financially rewards its employees for achieving a high level of success

• Ability to sell regionally and nationally

• 50+ years of successful business and streamlined processes based on industry leading best practices

• Hands-on executive management team dedicated to the overall success of the organization and its employees

• 9,000+ consultants internationally

Compensation:
Below is a breakdown of average incomes by Judge Salespeople who were employed for the entire year of 2025

• 37% of our Account Executives earned over $250,000

• 35% of our Account Executives earned between $150,000 and $250,000

• 14% of our Account Executives earned between $100,000 and $150,000

• 14% of our Account Executives earned between $75,000 and $100,000

Benefits:

• Competitive base salary, uncapped commission, and bonus with six figure earning potential

• Ability and incentives to cross sell technology, talent and learning solutions

• 401K match

• Generous client entertainment allowance

• Cell phone reimbursement and mileage reimbursement

• Annual incentive trips to exclusive vacation resorts

• Quarterly sales contests/incentives

Responsibilities
Primary Responsibilities:

• Hunting and breaking national/enterprise accounts in the region.

• Developing strategic account strategies and solutions for our clients, as well as influencing account growth within our existing enterprise accounts on an international basis.

• Integrating the entire portfolio of services across Judge, providing a coordinated communication, management, and delivery approach for national and international clients.

• Work in concert with executive leadership and EVP, Sales in leading and facilitating regional Strategies and action plans for the Enterprise Accounts Program.

• Cultivate and expand existing strategic accounts through frequent communication and executive/senior level client visits and working with local teams to develop new opportunities.

• Evaluate potential business opportunities by leveraging existing successful client projects, networks, and initiatives.

• Lead efforts to develop national accounts into global accounts

Qualifications
Experience Requirements:

• A minimum of 7-10 years of professional services sales experience, hunting and developing strategic and enterprise accounts that will eventually yield 7-10MM in annual revenues.

title: Email & SMS Manager | Colombia
description:
•

•

We’re looking for a highly organized, hands-on Email & SMS Manager to own the day-to-day execution and optimization of our retention marketing program.
This person will be responsible for building and managing our email and SMS calendar, developing flow and campaign strategies, working closely with our Email Designer, QAing campaigns before launch, analyzing performance, and proactively identifying opportunities to improve retention and revenue.
You’ll work closely with the Head of Growth and should be comfortable operating independently, keeping projects organized, and bringing forward issues and opportunities rather than waiting to be asked.
What you'll do
Email & SMS Strategy & Execution

• Own the weekly and monthly Email & SMS calendar.

• Build and optimize key lifecycle flows, including Welcome, Abandoned Browse, Abandoned Cart, Checkout, Post-Purchase, Winback, and other retention flows.

• Develop campaign concepts, messaging, segmentation.

• Translate strategy into clear briefs and proposals for the Email Designer.

• Work closely with the designer to ensure campaigns are executed according to brief.

• Manage campaigns from concept through launch.

QA & Optimization

• Own the full QA process before emails and SMS go live.

• Review copy, links, CTAs, segmentation, personalization, offers, mobile/desktop rendering, tracking, and overall customer experience.

• Monitor campaigns after launch and flag any issues quickly.

Reporting & Insights

• Own weekly Email & SMS reporting.

• Track key KPIs and clearly communicate performance, trends, and areas of concern.

• Provide actionable recommendations, not just numbers.

Requirements

• 3+ years of hands-on Email & SMS experience, ideally within DTC/e-commerce.

• Strong experience with Klaviyo and/or other lifecycle marketing platforms.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented. You naturally create structure where there isn't any.

• Strong copy and messaging instincts, even if you're not the person designing the emails.

• Comfortable working in Notion and Figma to create campaign proposals, briefs, flow maps, and presentations.

• Strong QA mindset. You catch things before they become problems.

• Proactive and comfortable working independently.

Success in this role looks like:

• A clear, well-managed Email & SMS calendar with campaigns consistently going out on time.

• Flows that are fully mapped, QA'd, optimized, and continuously tested.

• Strong collaboration between strategy, copy, and design.

• Reliable weekly reporting with clear insights and next steps.

• Problems are identified before they become bigger issues.

• A structured testing roadmap that continuously improves Email & SMS revenue and retention.

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - Solothurn
description:
Du hast noch nie im B2B-Vertrieb gearbeitet, möchtest aber gerne alle wichtigen Werkzeuge erlernen, um so richtig durchzustarten? Bei Salonkee lernst du den Vertrieb von Grund auf kennen und baust dir in Solothurn dein eigenes Netzwerk auf.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.
Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly , we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.
The Opportunity
We’re looking for an Account Executive who brings both SaaS sales expertise and a deep understanding of the CPG ecosystem . This is a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of technology, finance, and commercial strategy - selling a high-impact solution into organizations where trade spend directly influences revenue, margin, and growth. You will own the full sales cycle, lead complex, multi-stakeholder deals, and partner with senior leaders across Sales, Finance, and Operations to drive meaningful business outcomes.
What You’ll Do

• Own the full sales cycle - from prospecting through close - focused on acquiring new CPG customers

• Build and manage a pipeline through outbound prospecting, self-sourcing, and collaboration with SDR and Marketing teams

• Lead consultative discovery to uncover inefficiencies in trade spend, promotions, and revenue execution

• Translate customer challenges into quantified business value (e.g., ROI improvement, margin expansion, revenue lift)

• Navigate and align cross-functional buying groups , including Sales, Finance, Revenue Management, and Operations

• Drive complex, multi-threaded deals with multiple stakeholders and decision-makers

• Deliver tailored, value-based presentations that clearly articulate Vividly ’s impact

• Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure long-term customer value

• Consistently exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets through disciplined pipeline management

Who You Are
You are a consultative, value-driven seller who thrives in complex environments and understands how large organizations make decisions.
You bring a strong grasp of how CPG businesses operate and can confidently engage stakeholders across both commercial and financial functions. You are equally comfortable discussing margin impact with Finance as you are with execution challenges with Sales teams .
You are resourceful, proactive, and motivated by solving real business problems - not just closing deals.
What We’re Looking For
Required

• 5+ years of quota-carrying experience in SaaS sales, with a track record of closing complex, multi-threaded deals

•
Experience working in or selling into the CPG industry (brand, broker, retailer, or distributor ecosystem)

• Proven ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders , including Director, VP, and C-level executives

• Strong experience with consultative sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar)

• Demonstrated success in outbound prospecting and building pipeline independently

• Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills

Highly Preferred

• Experience with trade promotion, revenue management, retail execution, or deductions workflows

• Background selling data, analytics, or financial SaaS solutio

At Instacart , we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work-whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop-while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. QOVES is a biomedical startup that focuses on improving patient experiences in cosmetic medical clinics through software. In simple speak, we make software that uses A.I., computer vision, recommendation algorithms and other to predict how patients may look like after cosmetic surgery and to diagnose whether the surgery is even beneficial. Our goal is to turn the process of consultation for cosmetic surgery into a well defined, clinical procedure of diagnosis and visualisation through our software integrations with clinics.
Your Role

This involves conducting research into the latest papers and approaches into visualization and generative networks, finetuneing existing products and deploying endpoints to production to work with the rest of the team.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert - u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet . Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen. Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken. title: Operations & Automation Engineer – Renewable Energy
description:
OPERATIONS & AUTOMATION ENGINEER - RENEWABLE SUPPLY

Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Gestalte mit uns die nachhaltige Energieversorgung von morgen - und baue als Operations & Automation Engineer skalierbare Prozesse und Automatisierungslösungen auf, die trawa beim Wachstum unterstützen. trawa baut Europas führende B2B-Plattform für saubere Energie. Als Operations & Automation Engineer startest du im Customer Support - nicht weil Support deine Endstation ist, sondern weil direkter Kundenkontakt der beste Weg ist, zu verstehen, wo Automatisierung den größten Unterschied macht. Du entwickelst unseren KI-gestützten Ticket-Copilot weiter, baust die dafür nötige Tooling-Landschaft auf und erweiterst deinen Wirkungskreis Schritt für Schritt auf den gesamten Ops-Bereich. Dein Ziel: manuelle und wiederkehrende Aufgaben zu reduzieren und trawa dadurch effizienter, schneller und skalierbarer zu machen.

Als Operations & Automation Engineer übernimmst du folgende Aufgaben:

- Weiterentwicklung des Customer Support-Agenten: Du bist Owner unseres KI-gestützten Ticket-Copilots - von der Anforderungsdefinition über die technische Weiterentwicklung bis zur Integration in unsere Tooling-Landschaft (Velaris, Airtable, HubSpot). Du treibst die Automatisierung von Ticket-Assignment, Lösungsvorschlägen und Kundenkommunikation aktiv voran.

- Ownership der Tooling-Landschaft: Du evaluierst, implementierst und entwickelst die Tools weiter, die unser Ops-Team braucht - von dedizierten Ticketing-Systemen bis hin zu Automatisierungsplattformen. Du erkennst, wo aktuelle Tools an ihre Grenzen stoßen, und treibst die Einführung von Alternativen voran.

- Automatisierung im gesamten Ops-Bereich: Customer Support ist der Anfang. Gemeinsam mit angrenzenden Teams - Finance, Onboarding, Customer Success - identifizierst du weitere Automatisierungspotenziale, entwickelst Lösungen und hilfst so, Automatisierung bei trawa Schritt für Schritt weiter auszubauen.

title: Senior Clinical Trials Budget Analyst - Remote
description:
About Vitalief
Vitalief is a clinical research consulting firm focused exclusively on the clinical research industry, providing consulting, staffing, and technology-enabled services to academic medical centers, health systems, sponsors, CROs, and site networks. By combining deep subject matter expertise with the experience of senior research practitioners, we help organizations accelerate study activation, optimize operations, improve financial performance, and build scalable workforce solutions that reduce costs, increase efficiency, and advance clinical breakthroughs for patients.

The Role
As part of our growth, we are seeking a hands-on, detail-oriented, client-facing professional with deep clinical trial budgeting expertise to join Vitalief ’s Budgeting Outsourcing Services Team. This role is focused on directly supporting Academic Medical Centers (AMCs) and clinical research health systems with day-to-day budgeting, coverage analysis, and billing compliance activities.

Why Join Vitalief ?

•
Make an Impact: Support leading AMCs and health systems in improving clinical trial financial performance and compliance.

•
Innovation-Driven: Help modernize clinical trial budgeting and billing processes using technology and best practices.

•
People-First Culture: Thrive in an environment that fosters growth, innovation, and collaboration.

•
Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy 20 PTO days, 9 paid holidays, company-paid life insurance, short- and long-term disability, a 401(k)-retirement plan, and robust healthcare options.

•
Flexible & Remote-Friendly: Primarily remote with occasional travel (up to 10%).

•
Salary Range: $75,000 to $125,000 - Based on experience level.

Responsibilities

• Develop, build, and finalize clinical trial budgets for industry-sponsored studies (oncology and non-oncology) in collaboration with academic medical center (AMC) and health system stakeholders.

• Perform detailed Medicare Coverage Analyses (MCA) to accurately distinguish routine care from research-related costs in compliance with CMS guidelines.

• Configure and maintain study calendars, budgets, and billing grids within OnCore, ensuring alignment with protocol requirements and institutional billing practices.

• Support clinical trial start-up by ensuring accurate budget setup, billing designations, and downstream readiness for compliant invoicing and revenue capture.

• Lead or support budget negotiations with sponsors and CROs, advocating for fair market value and full cost recovery for AMCs and health systems.

• Partner closely with investigators, study coordinators, finance, and revenue cycle teams to validate assumptions and resolve budget or billing discrepancies.

• Conduct ongoing budget tracking, reconciliation, and variance analysis to ensure financial accuracy throughout the study lifecycle.

• Identify and mitigate billing compliance risks while ensuring adherence to CMS, FDA, NIH, and institutional policies.

• Standardize and improve budgeting and Medicare Coverage Analysis workflows, templates, and tools to increase efficiency and consistency across client engagements.

• Provide hands-on support across multiple client engagements, effectively managing competing priorities while delivering high-quality results.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree required; Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

• 3 to 5+ years of hands-on experience in clinical trial budgeting within an academic medical center or health system.

• Strong expertise in Medicare Coverage Analysis (MCA) and clinical trial billing compliance.

• Experience using a Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) to build study calendars, budgets, and billing grids; OnCore experience is strongly preferred.

• Proven experience negotiating clinical trial budgets with sponsors and CROs.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

As part of this team, you will design and develop the systems that power large-scale reconstruction, synthetic data generation, and log augmentation, along with the ML pipelines used to train and validate autonomy systems. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and machine learning, and who are excited to scale a state-of-the-art product while building new capabilities that solve the hardest data and platform gaps in Physical AI.

- Design and optimize storage solutions for structured, unstructured, and multimodal data (e.g., sensor, 3D, logs)

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerized systems (Docker, Kubernetes)

Die Univention GmbH steht für digitale Souveränität, offene IT-Infrastrukturen und Open-Source-basierte Softwarelösungen. Unser Ziel ist es, Organisationen - insbesondere aus öffentlicher Verwaltung und Bildung - sichere, unabhängige und gestaltbare IT-Umgebungen zu ermöglichen.

was du mitbringst

• Linux-Expertise: Du bist sicher in der Administration von Linux-Servern.

• Breites technisches Fundament: Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Netzwerken, DNS, Active Directory, LDAP, Containerisierung (Docker), APIs und Single Sign-on mit.

title: Product Designer

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Toast is building a unified, enterprise-grade inventory platform that will power inventory for every Toast location, Restaurants and Retail alike. We are seeking a highly skilled, AI-native Product Designer to shape that experience: someone with a strong portfolio, a focus on exceptional UI design, and the hands-on ability to build working prototypes with AI tools like Replit, Magic Patterns, or Claude. This role involves designing for the unique needs of a diverse customer base, including restaurants, hybrid models, convenience stores, bottle shops, grocery stores, and beyond.

You will be the product designer for inventory platform capabilities built by our Chennai teams, working day to day with a Chennai-based product manager counterpart and reporting to Toast Retail's design leadership in the U.S. Together you will turn product strategy into experiences customers can trust with their stock, their costs, and their books.

Why This Role Matters

Inventory is where a store's money sits. When stock counts are wrong, invoices are keyed in by hand, or costs don't reach the accounting system, owners lose margin and hours they don't have. The workflows you design will decide how supplier data, invoices, stock, costs, and revenue move through Toast and into our customers' accounting platforms, and whether the people doing that work, often at the end of a long shift, feel in control or buried in it.

You will be Toast Retail's design presence in our Chennai office: the on-site design partner for its product and engineering teams, and part of Toast's wider design community, including product designers in Bangalore. Because this work spans regions and time zones, the role calls for strong autonomous design judgment: keeping local teams unblocked, making well-informed design and scope tradeoffs within the broader product vision, and bringing US-based design, product, and business stakeholders in when direction, customer impact, or strategic choices need broader alignment.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

• Own design for your product area: Take your work from early discovery through shipped UI, connecting each workflow to the broader inventory platform vision.

• Prototype with AI: Use AI prototyping tools such as Replit, Magic Patterns, or Claude to build working, interactive prototypes with realistic data, so ideas can be tested with customers and engineers before the team commits to them. Use AI across the rest of your practice too, from synthesizing research to exploring concepts, validating outputs carefully and modeling responsible, secure use of AI for the team.

• Design AI-first workflows: Identify where AI can materially reduce customer effort, such as reading invoices, normalizing supplier and item data, and recommending catalog and accounting mappings. Design just as carefully for when it is unsure: how customers review low-confidence results, correct mistakes, and come to trust the system.

• Engage directly with customers: Research with retail and restaurant operators, and with the internal teams who support them, to understand their inventory needs, and translate those insights into design direction and testable ideas.

• Make complex data feel simple: Turn supplier catalogs, mappings, sync status, and errors into experiences that are clear, forgiving, and fast, on desktop and in the hand.

• Collaborate early and often: Partner closely with product managers and engineers in Chennai and the U.S., sharing work early, communicating design rationale clearly, and helping the team make good decisions quickly.

• Raise the craft bar: Deliver pixel-perfect UI, apply and extend the Toast design system with good judgment, and contribute to the quality of the wider Retail design practice.

The best managers in this role won't be directing from a distance; they'll be the person their reps turn to when a deal gets complicated. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage from a dashboard. It's a role for someone who wants to build something.

You'll inherit a team that has real momentum, as our Commercial segment represents a significant % of our overall business.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of Commercial Account Executives selling into the sub-250 employee segment - helping them close faster, think more technically, and operate with greater autonomy over time.

- Own the Commercial segment number. You're accountable for team attainment, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy - and you'll be expected to have a clear point of view on both at any given moment.

- Spend time in deals. Review deals, join customer conversations when it matters, and help your reps navigate the technical and commercial complexity that defines this segment.

- Hire exceptional people. The Commercial AE profile is rare: technically credible, commercially hungry, and able to operate without hand-holding. You know how to find and close that person.

- Build the playbook. Document what's working, codify best practices, and create repeatable frameworks for technical discovery, objection handling, and deal progression that the team can scale.

- Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Product, and Marketing to ensure the Commercial team has the support, enablement, and feedback loops they need to win.

- Identify patterns across the pipeline - where deals stall, where we lose, and where we consistently win - and use those insights to improve team performance and inform product and GTM decisions.

- Contribute to the broader Commercial strategy, including segmentation, coverage model, and how we evolve the motion as the team scales.

WHAT YOU BRING

- A track record of success as a quota-carrying AE in a technical sales environment - you've sold data infrastructure, developer tooling, or a similarly technical product to engineering buyers and you know what that motion actually requires.

- Experience leading or mentoring other sellers, whether in a formal management role or as a senior IC who took ownership of team development. You know how to coach, not just direct.

- Technical credibility. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to earn respect in rooms full of them. You understand the modern data stack, can hold a conversation about architecture, and know enough to identify when a deal is stalling for technical reasons vs. commercial ones.

- Strong commercial instincts. You can read a pipeline, spot sandbagging, identify risk early, and have an honest forecast conversation with leadership without needing a week to prepare.

- A builder mentality. The playbook is still being written. You're comfortable operating in that environment and energized by the opportunity to shape it rather than frustrated by the ambiguity.

title: People Programs Lead
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

People Programs at Ramp builds the programs that shape how employees experience the company day to day; from someone's first week to the moments that define Ramp's culture company-wide. As Ramp scales, we need someone dedicated to building that function and taking our foundations to the next level.

In this role, you'll own programs like onboarding, manager enablement, engagement surveys, and the company-wide culture and recognition programs that shape how Ramp works, to name a few. You'll work closely with People Business Partners, People Operations, and Comms to make these programs land and thrive.

This work is high impact and high visibility. This is a hands-on, build-from-scratch role for someone with strong judgment who owns things fully.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build your own roadmap by pulling signal from engagement survey results, PBP and manager input, and People Ops, then make the call on what to build, improve, delegate, or stop.

- Own onboarding effectiveness - from pre-start through the first week - so every new hire's first experience of Ramp reflects how we work and our culture, partnering with People Ops and IT on day-to-day logistics

- Own the performance review cycle's program design - timeline, tools, and the manager/employee experience - partnering with PBPs on calibration and outcomes

- Build and own manager enablement as a standalone program: design the content, frameworks, and moments that help managers lead well, in partnership with PBPs on delivery

- Conceive, build, and run company-wide culture-building programs, fully owning logistics and content end-to-end

- Own recognition programming: how we surface and celebrate what's worth celebrating across the company and the rituals/milestones that make Ramp's culture tangible day to day

- Own the biannual engagement survey: design, run, and work with People Business Partners to translate results into action

- Be the trusted voice on what we should build in-house versus buy (tools, vendors, platforms) for people programs, grounded in judgment about what's worth the investment, not a default toward either

WHAT YOU NEED

- 5+ years owning people/culture programs end-to-end at a high-growth company - from ideation through hands-on execution

- A builder's track record: you've created programming that didn't exist before, not adapted someone else's playbook

- Strong facilitation and executive presence. You’re comfortable being the face of a program in front of the whole company, not just behind the scenes

- Comfortable with data: you can read engagement survey results and program metrics and turn them into a point of view, not just a report

- Proven ability to partner across functions (PBPs, Comms, Enablement, leadership)

- First-principles thinker who can turn ambiguity into a scalable framework: you don't need a rule book, but you can build one when it's missing

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

title: Associate Director, Retail Media Search
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Role Summary & Impact

The Associate Director, Commerce Search will lead retail media search strategy and activation for a beauty-focused client portfolio, with an emphasis on navigating the unique commerce ecosystems of specialty retailers and department stores.

We’re looking for a commerce marketer who understands that retail media goes beyond Amazon and Walmart. The ideal candidate brings experience working with beauty, luxury, fashion, or similarly retail-driven brands and understands how brands engage consumers across retailers such as Ulta Beauty, Sephora, Macy’s, Nordstrom, Bloomingdale’s, and other specialty and department-store environments.

In this role, you’ll translate retailer, consumer, product, inventory, and performance insights into smart search and commerce activation strategies. You’ll lead campaign strategy and execution, develop keyword and optimization approaches, manage retail media investments, and partner directly with clients, retailers, and internal teams to drive measurable business results.

You’ll also manage and develop a team while helping clients navigate an increasingly complex retail media landscape. Strong retail media experience is essential; beauty or adjacent specialty retail experience is highly preferred.

What You’ll Do

• Lead search and retail media strategy and activation across multiple retailer environments.

• Own keyword strategy, campaign setup, bidding, budgeting, optimization, testing, and performance reporting.

• Bring a strong understanding of specialty and department-store commerce, particularly how brands drive growth across retailer partners.

• Translate retail considerations such as inventory, product availability, demand, profitability, promotions, and seasonality into media recommendations.

• Build strong relationships with client stakeholders, retailer media partners, and internal teams.

• Identify opportunities to connect retail search with the broader commerce and media ecosystem.

• Use performance data to identify trends and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations.

• Lead cross-channel testing and optimization strategies.

• Manage and develop direct reports, helping strengthen both their activation expertise and strategic capabilities.

• Stay ahead of developments across retail media platforms, ad products, technology, and measurement.

• Oversee campaign operations, including trafficking, billing/reconciliation, and data integrity.

Experience

• 5+ years of retail media, commerce search, paid ecommerce, or biddable performance media experience, with substantial hands-on retail search experience.

• Strongly preferred: experience supporting beauty, cosmetics, luxury, fashion, or another category heavily connected to specialty and department-store retail.

• Experience working with specialty retailers and/or department stores. Beauty retailer experience is especially relevant.

• Hands-on experience managing retail media/search campaigns and optimizing toward business and performance objectives.

• Experience across retail media and commerce platforms such as Amazon Ads, Criteo, Walmart Connect, Pacvue, and Skai, or comparable platforms.

• Strong understanding of how inventory, profitability, product availability, promotions, forecasting, and demand influence commerce media decisions.

The Equipment Finance Regional Sales Manager is primarily responsible for identifying, delivering, and executing the equipment finance sales strategy. • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Operations Management, or related field.

description:
Company Description
IntellaQuest provides quality-focused software for manufacturing organizations, including organizations with sensitive defense-related requirements. The company helps these teams manage quality, compliance, and operational complexity across their manufacturing environments.
IntellaQuest is a mission-critical quality, safety, and compliance platform embedded in the operations of global manufacturers like Honda, Subaru, and Harley-Davidson. Where manufacturers once relied on paper-based and fragmented processes, IntellaQuest delivers structured, auditable workflows that keep them audit-ready against standards including ISO 9001, ISO 14001, IATF 16949, and FDA 21 CFR Part 11, across automotive, chemicals, energy, and electronics.
With approximately 50 employees and a high-performing Technical Center in Skopje, Macedonia, IntellaQuest is entering its next phase of growth under new ownership, scaling the product, modernizing the platform, and building a repeatable SaaS operating model.
As part of ASG , IntellaQuest is backed by Alpine Investors. ASG acquires market-leading vertical SaaS companies and accelerates their transformation into AI-native platforms.
Job Description
IntellaQuest is looking for an Account Executive to win new logos across North America. This full-cycle B2B SaaS sales role will manage consultative mid-market and enterprise opportunities in manufacturing and related environments, working longer, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first conversation through close.
You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will:

• Own the full new-logo sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close.

• Build and manage pipeline across North American mid-market and enterprise accounts.

• Lead consultative discovery that connects customer manufacturing and quality challenges to IntellaQuest solutions.

• Navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes and maintain momentum through longer, complex sales cycles.

• Work toward an annual new-business quota, to be finalized upon approval.

• Maintain accurate opportunity, activity, and forecast data across HubSpot and Salesforce.

• Use Gong, Clay, and other approved sales tools to improve research, outreach, call preparation, and execution.

• Partner with Solutions Engineering and other internal teams to deliver credible evaluations, demonstrations, and customer handoffs.

We're Excited About You Because:

• You have 3+ years of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience.

• You have experience managing mid-market or enterprise sales motions with multiple stakeholders.

• You have strong consultative discovery, communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• You have demonstrated the ability to build pipeline and manage longer, complex sales cycles.

• You have experience using CRM and sales-engagement tools; familiarity with HubSpot, Salesforce, Gong, or Clay is helpful.

• You may have manufacturing or engineering experience, though it isn't required.

• You are comfortable operating independently in a remote, new-logo sales role.

Compensation and Benefits
Base Salary Range: $110,000 - $120,000 CAD, with an OTE of $190,000 - $230,000 CAD, as part of a competitive total rewards package including employer-paid benefits and incentive pay. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs annually at minimum to ensure competitive and fair pay.
Location
Remote, North America. Toronto is strongly preferred to support the development of a local team hub.

title: Analytics Engineer 5 - Ads Identity & Signals
description:
At Netflix , our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
In 2022 we launched a new lower-priced, ad-supported tier, and we are building an in-house, world-class ad-tech ecosystem to give our members more choice and to offer advertisers a premium, better-than-linear-TV experience. We are looking for the founding members of this new business area for Netflix .

The Identity & Signals team builds the identity foundation of the Netflix ads business - the graph and matching systems that let us recognize the same person or household across signals, devices, and partner data sources, and that determine which signals we can responsibly and accurately use for targeting, measurement, and reporting. We build and maintain the identity graph, run and evaluate entity-matching and resolution pipelines, and manage relationships with identity providers so that advertisers and internal teams can trust the signals underneath every campaign.

This is a foundational role on a small, high-leverage team. You will build the analytics and data infrastructure that powers identity matching and graph construction - designing the tables, pipelines, and metrics that let the team and its stakeholders understand match quality, coverage, and drift over time. You'll work end-to-end: from raw signal ingestion, through matching logic and graph construction, to the dashboards and data products that make identity health visible and actionable across the company.

In This Role, You Will

• Design, build, and maintain the data models and pipelines that support identity graph construction, entity matching, and identity resolution across first-party and third-party signals.

• Partner with data engineering and software engineering to productionize matching logic, ensuring pipelines are scalable, well-tested, and monitored for data quality and drift.

• Build metrics, dashboards, and analytics that quantify match rate, match quality, coverage, and graph stability, and that surface anomalies before they affect downstream campaigns.

• Work closely with data science to evaluate and improve matching algorithms, providing the clean, well-documented data and features needed to test and iterate on models.

• Manage and evaluate the analytics relationship with external identity providers (e.g., Experian, TransUnion, LiveRamp), including onboarding new sources, validating match performance, and monitoring ongoing data quality.

• Translate identity graph and matching concepts - nodes, edges, match confidence, deterministic vs. probabilistic matching - into clear, actionable insights for product, sales, and other non-technical stakeholders.

• Collaborate with product and cross-functional partners to define identity requirements, evaluate trade-offs (accuracy vs. coverage vs. privacy), and prioritize roadmap work.

• Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences at all levels of the company.

We Are Looking For

• 5+ years of experience as an analytics engineer, data engineer, or similar role working with large-scale data.

• Experience working with graph data structures and graph-based data models (e.g., property graphs, graph databases, or graph analytics on top of relational/columnar stores).

• Familiarity with entity matching / identity resolution concepts - deterministic and probabilistic matching, fuzzy matching, blocking/candidate generation, and match quality evaluation.

• Knowledge of, or direct experience working with, identity providers such as Experian, TransUnion, LiveRamp, or similar data/identity partners.

• Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience building and maintaining prod

title: Staff Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

 

Architecting the sub-millisecond decision engine that powers 200 million daily ad interactions

 

The Demand Core team and backend platform squads build the foundational infrastructure that determines which of our thousands of active advertising campaigns are relevant to a user the moment they open Playtime. At our scale, system latency is a business failure: downtime means advertisers stop spending, users stop earning rewards, and publisher revenue stalls. As a Staff Backend Developer, you will own the architectural integrity, reliability, and long-term evolution of the distributed systems that power these decisions 200 million times every day across multiple teams.

Go microservices load the active ad campaign catalog into memory, evaluating 40+ targeting constraints and 30+ real-time signals like geo, fraud status, budget caps, to rank potential user performance in milliseconds. Beyond individual services, you will define architectural patterns across the entire ad interaction chain: high-throughput processing of clicks, views, MMP postbacks from Adjust and AppsFlyer, and reward-triggering in-app events. You will govern our hybrid messaging architecture using SNS/SQS and Kafka, standardize backend data patterns across DynamoDB, relational, and analytical data stores, and ensure our core ad scoring pipelines remain resilient under massive load.

 

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

 

- Production Golang Systems & Architecture Mastery: You bring extensive backend development experience (7+ years, with deep production Go expertise in distributed environments). You will define service boundaries, concurrency models, and runtime optimizations for our +99% Go microservice architecture, scaling the platform reliably beyond hundreds of millions of monthly active users.

- High-Throughput Event Streaming & Architecture Patterns: You have deep experience architecting and standardizing asynchronous microservice communication using event backbones like Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Kinesis. You will establish org-wide streaming standards, schema evolution, and CDC patterns to process billions of daily API events and aggregate them into our data lake for sub-second querying.

- Large-Scale Data Architecture & Platform Optimization: You understand database internals, distributed storage trade-offs, and low-level web standards. You will standardize data patterns (sharding, replication, DR) across hundreds of terabytes in DynamoDB, MySQL, Druid, and Athena, while leading high-stakes, zero-downtime database migrations and deprecations.

- Data Science & Algorithmic Integration at Scale: You quickly grasp complex technical topics, distributed systems trade-offs, and applied mathematics. You will partner with our Data Science team to architect the runtime infrastructure that serves predictive models and machine learning algorithms directly within our sub-millisecond real-time ad targeting engine.

- Technical Leadership & Organizational Leverage: You communicate fluently and precisely in spoken and written English. You drive alignment across squads through RFCs and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), define org-level SLIs/SLOs, sponsor major technical migrations, and mentor Senior engineers across an international engineering team.

- Plus: Cloud Resilience & Tooling: Hands-on experience with continuous profiling (e.g., Pyroscope, goroutine dumps), chaos engineering drills, and infrastructure automation using Terraform, Kubernetes, or AWS cloud networking.

title: Lead Backend Engineer, Service Standards
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Lead Backend Engineer in the Service Standards team, you will shape how services are built, deployed, and operated across all of Vinted. You will work closely with a team on the development of our core service framework-providing engineering teams with golden paths, robust service contracts, standardized tooling, and performance benchmarks to ensure high reliability and developer velocity at scale.

You will sit in the Service Standards team, part of the Service Ecosystem domain, reporting to the Engineering Manager of that team.

The Service Standards team is responsible for standardizing service startup, consumer APIs, and foundational backend frameworks across Vinted's engineering landscape. Within it, this is a senior individual-contributor role combining technical leadership with high autonomy-you will define architectural directions, establish best practices, and guide engineers across domains without requiring full management overhead.

You will collaborate closely with platform, observability, and product engineering teams to ensure our service framework and standards seamlessly integrate into daily workflows. Your work will directly impact developer experience, platform reliability, and system performance as Vinted continues to scale.

In this position, you’ll 

• Lead the technical direction and design around service standards and golden paths.

• Define and evolve company-wide service standards, including consumer APIs, service contracts, startup routines, and performance guidelines.

• Build reusable backend libraries, tools, and scaffolding to streamline new service creation and maintenance.

• Partner with backend engineers across domains to drive adoption of framework updates and gather continuous feedback.

• Evaluate pragmatic trade-offs between architectural consistency, delivery speed, and technical debt across the platform.

• Collaborate with Observability and Infrastructure teams to integrate telemetry, SLOs, and resilience practices into standard service templates.

• Ensure security, privacy, and compliance guidelines are embedded directly into service contracts and framework templates.

• Mentor senior backend engineers, participate in architectural design reviews, and foster high engineering standards across teams.

• Drive architectural proposals (RFCs/ADRs) for platform-wide backend standardization.

About you 

• Have deep backend engineering experience and strong architectural intuition, with proven success building scalable service

title: Senior Procurement Manager – Infrastructure Complex Deals
description:
About the team

Hardware Procurement Operations enables OpenAI’s hardware and infrastructure businesses to execute supplier engagements and purchases at speed while maintaining financial discipline, clear ownership, and effective controls.

Our work spans procurement execution, process and systems enablement, and lifecycle governance-from initial requests and agreements through purchasing, payment, and closeout, with related asset and inventory governance. We build practical operating models, resolve cross-functional barriers, and improve the tools and processes that help teams scale.

About the role

You will own procurement execution for complex infrastructure deals, including land transactions, lease agreements, power purchase agreements, and fast-moving colocation and fiber engagements. Scope may expand to cloud service provider (CSP) engagements and sourcing activities as business needs evolve.

This senior individual contributor role combines hands-on lifecycle management with commercial judgment and building scalable operations. You will recognize gaps in proposed supplier engagements, work with business owners, sourcing, Legal, and Finance to improve them, and translate agreements into executable purchasing and payment plans. You will also build standard processes and automation that help teams move faster while reducing deal risk.

In this role, you will:

- Drive assigned engagements from intake and agreement execution through purchasing, ongoing obligations, amendments, renewals, final payments, and closeout.

- Assess commercial and operational readiness, identify gaps in scope, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and payment terms, and drive resolution with the appropriate partners.

- Resolve commercial, financial, and operational dependencies, aligning owners on required reviews and approvals. Represent procurement operations in deal planning and senior stakeholder escalations, presenting clear recommendations on commercial readiness, risks, and execution tradeoffs while respecting each function’s decision authority.

- Maintain accurate obligation and purchasing records; coordinate payment readiness, acceptance evidence, invoice exceptions, and reconciliation with business owners, Treasury, Accounting, and Accounts Payable.

- Establish procurement operating standards and influence business, sourcing, Legal, and Finance partners to adopt practices that improve supplier engagement quality, accelerate execution, and reduce risk. Build the processes, templates, playbooks, and upstream review cycles that make those standards actionable.

- Design, implement, and manage workflow automation and AI agents, partnering with technical teams where needed; own testing, adoption, monitoring, exception handling, and appropriate human review and approval controls.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have independently managed complex procurement engagements through post-signature execution and closeout, with experience in at least one infrastructure category such as land, leases, power, colocation, or fiber.

- Can distinguish well-structured supplier engagements from those that create avoidable ambiguity or exposure, recommend practical improvements, and recognize when Legal or Accounting judgment is required.

- Understand contractual obligations, payment structures, and procurement controls, and can translate them into clear execution plans.

- Can independently prioritize time-sensitive engagements, navigate ambiguity, and resolve cross-functional dependencies, seeking guidance on complex or consequential decisions. Communicate risks and tradeoffs clearly and influence senior stakeholders without formal authority.

- Have built repeatable processes in an ambiguous environment and use procurement, contract management, and ERP systems and operational data to improve execution.

- Have delivered workflow automation or AI agent solutions with measurable results and can manage their reliability, exceptions, and controls.

description:
We’re Sharp Performance

Sharp Performance exists so that everyone who answers the call has someone in their corner who has walked in their shoes.

We help first responders and their spouses thrive through confidential coaching from people with similar lived experience. Our coaches have carried the badge, worn the gear, or stood beside someone who did. Through our mobile platform, we connect law enforcement, firefighters, and other frontline professionals with coaches who understand the job because they have lived it.

We’re early-stage and backed by amazing investors. The team is small enough that your work shows up in the rollout, the product, and the customer’s experience within weeks. If building something that matters alongside people who hold a high standard sounds better than a safe seat somewhere else, come build it with us.

The Opportunity

We’re hiring a Talent Coordinator to run the hiring engine that brings great people onto the Sharp team. This role reports to the Senior Recruiter.

Every hire at an early-stage company matters, and every candidate forms an opinion of Sharp from how we treat them. You own the logistics that make hiring fast, organized, and human: scheduling, interview panels, candidate communication, offer letters, ATS hygiene, and the handoff to onboarding. Recruiters and hiring managers focus on finding and assessing talent. You make sure the process around them never slows down.

You will work closely with Recruiting, People Ops, and hiring managers across Sales, Product, Coaching, and Engineering.

This role is Remote, with occasional travel to Carlsbad, CA as the work requires.

What You’ll Own

•
Scheduling: Coordinate phone screens, interview loops and final rounds across time zones and busy calendars. Reschedule quickly when plans change without losing momentum.

•
Interview panels: Build balanced panels with hiring managers, send interviewers prep materials and scorecards, and chase feedback so decisions happen within 48 hours.

•
Candidate communication: Be the main point of contact for candidates in process. Send confirmations, reminders and status updates, and make sure no one is left waiting without an answer.

•
Offer letters: Draft and send offer letters from approved templates, route them for approval and track signatures through close.

•
ATS hygiene: Keep every requisition, candidate stage, disposition and note accurate in our ATS. Clean data lets us report on pipeline and time to hire with confidence.

•
Handoff to onboarding: Once an offer is signed, pass a complete, accurate record to People Ops so new hires get equipment, accounts and a warm welcome on day one.

•
Process improvement: Spot friction in our hiring process and suggest templates, automations or workflow changes that save time for candidates and the team.

The Numbers

Two numbers define success in this role. You will set the targets with your manager in your first 90 days and own them after that:

•
Candidate speed. Time from stage change to scheduled interview, interview-to-feedback turnaround (target: 48 hours), and time from verbal offer to signed offer letter. Reported by role, weekly.

•
Candidate experience and data quality. Candidate experience survey scores, no candidate waiting more than two business days for an update, and an ATS clean enough that pipeline reports need no manual fixes.

About SafelyYou

SafelyYou ’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person-centered care across senior living through world-leading AI, industry-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities.

Originating in 2015 as the doctoral research of CEO George Netscher-and inspired by his own family's experience with Alzheimer's disease- SafelyYou was spun out of UC Berkeley’s Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, one of the top five AI research groups in the world. And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. All helping ensure that communities can focus on improved care for residents while still reaching their financial goals.

SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation.
Your Role at SafelyYou
SafelyYou is looking for a builder - a Director of FP&A who will own and shape the financial
planning function at a pivotal moment in our growth. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role reporting directly to the VP of Finance. You will be the primary architect of how we plan, forecast, and measure financial performance across a business with both SaaS and hardware dimensions.
We’re looking for someone who can translate numbers into stories to drive decisions - who understands that the value of FP&A is not in the outputs it produces, but in the actions it enables.
You will work directly with the CEO, COO, and department heads to ensure financial clarity drives better resource allocation, faster decision-making, sharper forecasting, and stronger operating discipline.
You will inherit an existing foundation - financial models, budgets, and reporting packages are in place- and will have the opportunity to assess, refine, and, where necessary, rebuild them, maturing the function to match our next stage of growth.
This is a director-level individual contributor role to start, with the understanding that, as the function is built out, external or internal resources could be added to build out a small team over the next few years.
Salary Range: $170,000 to $190,000 annually
Key Responsibilities:
Financial Planning

• Lead the annual budget and mid-year budget refresh processes across all functions, with clear ownership of planning dimensions by cost center, headcount, product line, and customer type

• Develop and maintain a long-range financial plan that connects strategic objectives to operating assumptions

• Work with senior leaders to set sales and revenue targets by product, for both contracted and utilization models

• Partner with HR and Operations to support headcount planning by building models for both operational and COGS resource allocation, evaluating short-term and long-term trade-offs

Forecasting

• Partner with sales and business development to build robust pipeline and sales forecast models, providing operational teams with timely visibility into volume, timing, and resource requirements

• Maintain a risk and opportunity tracker updated monthly, surfacing material variances before they land in the actuals

• Build and maintain SaaS and hardware-specific forecasting models incorporating ARR, net revenue retention, churn, implementation pipeline, and inventory purchase and deployment schedules

Performance Reporting

• Design and own the monthly management reporting package for internal leadership and quarterly board decks
